fields.summary: SAP SuccessFactors replication drops cost centre for rehires

content.text: Employees rehired within 12 months replicate from SuccessFactors to eBlox without a cost centre, so their salary posts to the default centre. Workaround: re-run the mapping job INT-MAP-07 after the nightly replication. Fix scheduled for the October integration release.

fields.summary: eBlox meal voucher validation rejects €8.00 face value

content.text: Setting the meal voucher face value to exactly €8.00 fails validation in eBlox 2026.09 although €8 is the legal maximum. Workaround: enter 7.99 until the hotfix. Hotfix planned for eBlox 2026.09.2.
